segments.text: Who will be driving the buses next week?
Busmen have decided to go on strike next week.
segments.translation: 公交司机决定下周举行罢工。

segments.text: The strike is due to begin on Tuesday.
No one knows how long it will last.
segments.translation: 没有人知道会持续多久。

segments.text: The busmen have stated that the strike will continue until general agreement is reached about pay and working conditions.
segments.translation: 公交司机们声称，罢工将持续到就工资和工作条件达成全面协议为止。

segments.text: Most people believe that the strike will last for at least a week.
segments.translation: 大多数人认为罢工至少会持续一周。

segments.text: Many owners of private cars are going to offer 'free rides' to people on their way to work.
segments.translation: 许多私家车车主将为上班途中的人提供'免费搭乘'。

segments.text: This will relieve pressure on the trains to some extent.
segments.translation: 这将在一定程度上减轻火车的压力。

segments.text: Meanwhile, a number of university students have volunteered to drive buses while the strike lasts.
segments.translation: 与此同时，一些大学生自愿在罢工期间驾驶公交车。

segments.text: All the students are expert drivers,
segments.translation: 所有学生都是熟练的司机，

segments.text: but before they drive any of the buses, they will have to pass a special test.
segments.translation: 但在驾驶任何公交车之前，他们必须通过一项特殊的测试。

segments.text: The students are going to take the test in two days' time.
segments.translation: 学生们将在两天后参加考试。

segments.text: Even so, people are going to find it difficult to get to work.
segments.translation: 尽管如此，人们还是会发现上班很困难。

segments.text: But so far, the public has expressed its gratitude to the students in lettters to the Press.
segments.translation: 但到目前为止，公众已通过给报社写信表达了对学生们的感谢。

segments.text: Only one or two people have objected that the students will drive too fast!
segments.translation: 只有一两个人反对说学生们会开得太快！
